name: Niimura Kou
source:
One of the original participants.

He is an IT technician who has a love for programming. He much prefers to be a loner and is shown to be distrustful of the other participants, even being described as lacking sympathy. Still, he's very smart and has a sharp intuition.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Kou_Niimura]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
